text:
marie: Quick heads-up — onboarding Nebula-7B to the hosted catalog. CI on dedicated-runner is failing during Triton kernel selection, and I want a quick check on weights location + tokenizer quirks + whether a container rebuild is needed. Logs below.

ci-bot: (CI) test-runner/nebula-onboard #42 FAILED
ci-bot: error: Triton backend returned KERNEL_NOT_FOUND for op 'attention' on compute 8.0

aj: Where are the weights in S3? path?
marie: s3://redwood-models/nebula/7b/2026-03-12/
marie: manifest: model.bin, config.json, tokenizer.json, merges.txt

diego: Triton complaining about compute capability — our Triton image is built for CUDA 11.8 kernels. Nebula wheel expects 12.x kernels for optimized fused attention. Did the builder pick the new nvcc flags? Logs:

ci-bot: builder: docker: FROM nvcr.io/nvidia/tritonserver:23.06-py3
ci-bot: builder: nvcc: --gpu-arch=compute_80

jin: Tokenizer note: Nebula tokenizer uses <|s|> as start token but tokenizer.json has bos_token_id=0 while model expects 1. This causes off-by-one decode issues on tests.
jin: quick fix: set tokenizer.json "bos_token_id": 1 and update merges if needed.

sam: For the Triton kernel mismatch, try forcing fallback kernel in runtime config for now:

```
runtime:
  triton:
    force_compat_kernels: true
    cuda_version: 12.1
```

sam: If that works we can avoid a full image rebuild while Diego investigates builder flags.

diego: Also check container base image tag — if it's 23.06 it's CUDA 12+? I recall 23.06 maps to CUDA 12.2, but our toolchain expects 11.8. We need to align.

marie: Can someone try: 1) patch tokenizer.json bos_token_id -> 1; 2) set force_compat_kernels true and rerun CI; 3) report back if kernel error changes to fallback or runtime error changes.

aj: I'll run the quick patch on the feature branch and re-trigger CI. ETA 20m.

ci-bot: (CI) patch apply + re-run triggered by aj

marie: thx — if CI still fails, Diego can you capture full triton logs and we may need a container rebuild with nvcc flags:

```
docker build --build-arg CUDA_VERSION=12.1 --build-arg NVCC_FLAGS="-gencode arch=compute_80,code=sm_80" -t rwood/triton:nebula-12.1 .
```

jin: Also leaving a note: tokenizer merges.txt is legacy bpe, merges count changed; if we change bos_token_id, run quick synthetic decode.

sam: ping @diego once CI finishes so we coordinate fallback vs rebuild decision.

marie: @aj please paste CI link and logs when done.

aj: https://ci.redwood.internal/patches/nebula/42 - re-run started

ci-bot: (CI) nebula-onboard #42 - step 'unit-tests' still running

marie: appreciate it. If unit-tests pass, we'll do a small integration run to verify sample prompts decode correctly.

diego: noted — will be on-call after 30m, can take container rebuild if needed.

sam: lgtm

aj: update: unit-tests passed, integration failing with same KERNEL_NOT_FOUND -> attaching triton-dump:

ci-bot: triton: selected backend 'tensorrt' for attention: kernel not available for sm_80 fused_attention
ci-bot: fallback: trying 'reference' kernel -> success but slower

marie: okay that's actually better than a crash — reference kernel passes. We'll ship with force_compat_kernels=true for now and schedule a proper optimized kernel build. Create a follow-up ticket for optimized kernel + builder flags.

aj: created ticket: https://issues.redwood/infra/NEBULA-12

marie: Thanks everyone. Closing this thread once ticket has assignee. :thumbsup:
